source.class: independent provider-effect durability component; not itself a self-improvement/evaluation controller

observed_contract.stable_effect_identity: create_or_get first-writer-wins under a unique idempotency key; provider_key is derived once from effect_id+tool and stable across retries
observed_contract.pre_dispatch_durable_state: effect transitions APPROVED→STARTED with lease before handler/provider call
observed_contract.provider_visible_key: current_effect().provider_key is explicitly intended to be passed to provider-native idempotency mechanisms such as Stripe Idempotency-Key
observed_contract.ambiguous_outcome: crash/timeout after STARTED but before RECEIPT_RECORDED becomes UNKNOWN; runtime does not blind-retry it
observed_contract.external_reconciliation: Reconciler probes provider; HAPPENED requires receipt when enforcement is on, NOT_HAPPENED re-arms only when provider capability says a miss is authoritative, INCONCLUSIVE/no prober escalates
observed_contract.receipt_contract: optional strict provider capability checks bind required handler args, idempotency fields and receipt fields/source fields; mismatch fails closed
observed_contract.duplicate_behavior: same logical effect replays cached success/failure or waits on in-flight execution instead of re-executing

important_limit: OpenOnce protects external side effects but does not supply the self-improvement-specific statistical/evaluation semantics: no candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, no cross-candidate error spending, no notion that a scarce holdout query must be charged exactly once regardless of provider retry. It is a component, not the complete target system.

composition.logical_evaluation_layer: AegisEvo stable evaluation job/fencing from clean sequence 79/81
composition.provider_effect_layer: OpenOnce-style stable provider_key + STARTED/UNKNOWN/RECEIPT_RECORDED/COMMITTED + provider probe/receipt reconciliation
composition.physical_attempt_evidence: dsh-autoresearch immutable evaluator attempt evidence from clean sequence 78
composition.still_missing: durable one-time logical query/statistical reservation and atomic one-time feedback/statistical transition bound to promotion

minimal_integration_test: create one stable logical evaluation job and reserve query/statistical budget before dispatch
derive one provider effect key from logical_evaluation_id/call-index/input digest
persist provider STARTED before network call
provider succeeds; kill worker before local result settlement
reconciler must either recover same provider receipt/result or stay UNKNOWN; it must not issue an uncharged second provider effect
selection feedback/statistical update must occur at most once
promotion must reference exact logical evaluation/statistical state and candidate artifact
next_frontier: Find the remaining statistical-consumption component in a public self-improving/autoresearch system: durable logical query reservation before evaluation, candidate-local sequential-valid evidence, proposal-crossing spending, and crash-safe one-time feedback/statistical update. Prefer systems with real remote/stochastic judges and SIGKILL tests.
